title: Member Flexible Rate Benefit Note: Parking Savings Multiplier for Ashbury Rewards Elites (Guest Folios)
content:
Reservations on the Member Flexible Rate carry a multiplier on the Ashbury Rewards self-parking savings posted to Guest Folios, for elite members.

**Note.** Member-rate multiplier: when the reservation is on the Member Flexible Rate and the member holds Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite, the self-parking savings are multiplied by the top-tier member-rate multiplier of 1.5; when the reservation is on the Member Flexible Rate and the member holds Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite, Gold Elite or Platinum Elite, by the member-rate multiplier of 1.25; otherwise they are not multiplied. The multiplier acts on the savings after the percentage has been applied and before the final rounding.

The rate plan is read from the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio, and the tier from the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

## Combinations

| Rate plan on the Room Reservations record | Ashbury Rewards tier | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Member Flexible Rate | Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 1.5 |
| Member Flexible Rate | Silver Elite, Gold Elite or Platinum Elite | 1.25 |
| Member Flexible Rate | Member | Not multiplied |
| Any other rate plan | Any tier | Not multiplied |

## Worked figures (hypothetical savings before the multiplier)

- **Titanium Elite on the Member Flexible Rate.** Savings worked out from the percentage of $7.35, multiplied by 1.5, is $11.025; rounded half up to the cent, $11.03.
- **Gold Elite on the Member Flexible Rate.** Savings of $7.35 multiplied by 1.25 is $9.1875; rounded half up to the cent, $9.19.
- **Ambassador Elite on the Flexible Rate.** Not on the Member Flexible Rate: not multiplied.
